scope: Exploratory no-training comparison of the fixed MedBook replay views and a larger probe on previously seen but never replayed training items. Evaluate original and rotated option orders, matching the completed semantic training study.
retained: 291 questions times two fixed order views. Reproduce the calibrated starting decisions and use the same scored denominator for all checkpoints.
never_replayed: All 872 prepared MedBook training questions outside the historical 338-item pool, including no historical-eligible item. Paired against the shared starting checkpoint for all comparisons. These questions were used in initial training and are not a validation or test split.
privacy: Only release aggregate counts. Private bits are saved without original questions or answers.
